- Current traffic pattern: baseline 300 QPS (avg), peak 1800 QPS (weekend promos), token profile: avg 45 tokens/request, 150 token peak; avg tokens/sec target ~13500 tps peak.

- Workshop goals: validate baseline QPS->GPU mapping, map batching windows, quantify KV-cache hit uplift, define canary/rollback plan, estimate reserved GPU count and burst pool sizing.
- Security/compliance: must support VPC peering, customer KMS, audit logging to SIEM, EU data residency for a subset of accounts.
- Quote from CTO: "We need hard throughput guarantees for launch month; soft price for burst capacity."
